connect.title: Connect Android Device
connect.subtitle: Connect your Android device via USB and enable USB debugging.
connect.subtitleWizard: The wizard will automatically run a full default acquisition — no configuration required.
connect.req2: Android device with USB debugging enabled
connect.req3: USB cable connected to your computer
connect.req4: Desktop ADB server must be stopped (run: adb kill-server)
connect.usbStep2: Go to <bold>About phone</bold> and tap <bold>Build number</bold> 7 times

acquisition.title: Select Acquisitions
acquisition.keepConnected: Acquisition in progress — please keep the device connected…
acquisition.zipDownloaded: The ZIP archive has been downloaded to your device.
acquisition.tabDisabledDuringAcquisition: Cannot switch tabs during an active acquisition
acquisition.langDisabledDuringAcquisition: Cannot change language during an active acquisition

states.completed: Archive finalised — all requested modules succeeded

invite.title: Analyst invitation
invite.intro: A protected delivery needs the invitation prepared by the analyst. It only holds public information: the analyst's public key, a pseudonymous case reference and the modules to collect.
invite.pasteLabel: Paste the invitation link or code
invite.loadedFromLink: Invitation loaded from the link. The address bar has been cleaned.
invite.analystLabelNote: descriptive only, not an identity certification
invite.notSecret: The invitation is neither secret nor authenticated: on its own it does not prove who sent it. The next step exists to verify exactly that.

errors.not-base64url: The invitation is not correctly encoded. Copy it again in full.
errors.not-json: The invitation content is not readable.
errors.unsupported-version: This invitation version is not supported by this WAFB build.
errors.bad-case-ref: The case reference is not valid.
errors.bad-profile: The invitation does not list valid modules.
errors.bad-label: The analyst label is not valid.
errors.bad-expiry: The invitation expiry date is not valid.
errors.expired: The invitation has expired. Ask the analyst for a new one.
errors.bad-recipient: The key in the invitation cannot be used.

recipientErrors.too-long: The text is too long to be an age public key.
recipientErrors.private-key: This looks like an age PRIVATE key. Do not share it with anyone. WAFB needs the analyst's PUBLIC key, which starts with "age1".
recipientErrors.ssh-key: SSH keys are not supported. An age X25519 public key starting with "age1" is required.
recipientErrors.unsupported-age-type: This age key type is not supported. Only X25519 keys ("age1…", 62 characters) are accepted.
recipientErrors.mixed-case: The key mixes upper- and lower-case letters, so it is not valid. Copy it again.
recipientErrors.not-age-recipient: This is not an age public key: it should start with "age1".
recipientErrors.malformed: The key is not a well-formed age X25519 public key. Copy it again.
recipientErrors.rejected-by-library: The age library cannot use this key for encryption.

verify.title: Verify the recipient
verify.intro: Artefacts will be encrypted so that only the holder of the matching private key can read them. Before starting, check that this fingerprint really belongs to your analyst.
verify.howTo: Compare it in full with the fingerprint the analyst gives you over a channel different from the invitation and already verified: a call to a number you know, an in-person meeting, an already verified chat. Two messages in the same account are not two independent channels.
verify.notAdb: Note: the code shown on the phone when you connect USB is something else (it authorises the computer) and must not be compared with this fingerprint.
verify.methodEnter: I enter the fingerprint I received from the analyst
verify.methodVoice: I compared all 64 characters with the analyst by voice
verify.methodPerson: I compared all 64 characters with the analyst in person
verify.methodOther: I compared it over another authenticated channel
verify.attest: I confirm I compared the whole fingerprint, not just its start or end
verify.mismatch: The fingerprint does NOT match. Do not start the acquisition: contact the analyst through the channel you have already verified.
verify.confirmedNote: This confirmation records the procedure you declared; it is not a cryptographic authentication of the analyst.
verify.change: Changing the recipient requires a new session.

preflight.title: Preliminary checks
preflight.secureContext: Page loaded in a secure context (HTTPS)
preflight.fsAccess: Direct file writing available (saving without an in-memory copy)
preflight.ok: This browser supports the protected path.
preflight.blocked: This browser cannot run the protected path. Use a recent desktop Chrome or Edge. No alternative download is offered, because it would require holding the whole archive in memory.

destination.title: Where to save the archive
destination.intro: Choose the file WAFB will write the encrypted archive to. Writing happens while data arrives from the phone.
destination.choose: Choose where to save the archive
destination.dismissed: No file chosen. You can try again whenever you want.
destination.failed: The browser could not open the file for writing. Choose another destination.

scope.title: Modules to collect
scope.fromInvite: List requested by the analyst. If you remove any, the change will be recorded in the manifest.
scope.removed: Modules removed with respect to the invitation
scope.personalData: Artefacts may contain personal data about you and other people (contacts, messages, logs).
scope.added: Added with respect to the invitation: will be recorded in the manifest

session.unknownTotal: total size not known in advance
session.keepConnected: Keep the phone connected and unlocked. If the phone asks for a confirmation (e.g. for the backup), answer on the phone.
session.stopConfirm: Stop the session? The archive will NOT be finalised and the data collected so far will not be usable. Retrying requires a new session.
session.encryptionActive: Encryption active for the verified recipient
session.lockMeaning: The lock only means data is being encrypted for the analyst: it says nothing about the security of this computer or the truthfulness of the data.

summary.title: Summary
summary.deliveryRefHelp: Give this code to the analyst over the already verified channel, separately from the file. It lets them confirm that the archive they receive is exactly the one produced here. Do not store it only inside the archive.
summary.whatToSend: What to send: only the .zip file, through the agreed channel. No private key must accompany it: you do not hold one and must not receive one.
summary.notClean: This result does not mean the device is free of compromise and it is not a complete forensic image: it documents what was requested, what was collected and what did not succeed.
summary.notSaved: Saving was NOT confirmed. Even if a file with that name appears in the folder, it must not be delivered.
summary.partialFileUnknown: Whether the browser removed the partial file has not been verified.
summary.afterwards: Afterwards, agree with the analyst whether to turn off USB debugging on the phone.

advanced.legacyWarning: In legacy mode artefacts and manifest are saved in clear, as in WAFB 0.3.1. Anyone who obtains the file can read them. This mode is never an automatic fallback for the protected mode.
advanced.legacyAck: I understand the archive will not be encrypted
advanced.manualRecipient: Or enter the analyst's public key directly

wizard.needsInvite: The guided procedure needs an invitation from the analyst. If you do not have one, contact the analyst.

analyst.intro: This page is for the analyst: prepare the key pair and the invitation, then verify and decrypt the archive you receive. Everything happens in this browser; the private key is never sent to a server nor stored in the browser.
analyst.loadPaste: Paste the private key (AGE-SECRET-KEY-1…) or choose the file
analyst.keyId: Fingerprint to give the acquirer over an independent channel
analyst.privateKeyHidden: Kept only in memory on this page. It never appears in the URL, browser storage or logs.
analyst.savePrivate: Save the private key to a file
analyst.savedWarn: Keep the file somewhere protected. If you lose it, archives encrypted for this key can no longer be decrypted; if it is stolen, whoever holds it can decrypt them. Changing key only protects future acquisitions.
analyst.selfTestIntro: Before sending the invitation, check that the loaded private key decrypts test data.
analyst.selfTestOk: Test passed: the private key decrypts what is encrypted for this public key.
analyst.selfTestFail: Test FAILED: the private key does not match. Do not send the invitation.
analyst.inviteNeedsTest: Complete the encryption and decryption test first.
analyst.caseRefHelp: Do not use names, investigation details or serial numbers: the invitation is not secret.
analyst.label: Label (optional, descriptive)
analyst.expiresHelp: Only an application start rule, not a cryptographic expiry of the data.
analyst.linkHelp: Send the link over the operational channel. Give the fingerprint over a different, already authenticated channel.
analyst.verifyNeedsKey: Load the case private key first.
analyst.expectedCase: Case reference according to your records
analyst.expectedRef: Delivery reference given by the acquirer (SHA-256)
analyst.expectedRefHelp: Without this reference it is not possible to rule out a coherent replacement package.

verdict.verified-complete: Delivery verified: archive intact and acquisition complete
verdict.verified-partial: Archive intact, but acquisition PARTIAL or incomplete
verdict.rejected: Archive REJECTED: do not use its content

analyst.exportOnlyVerified: Only complete artefacts whose hash matches can be saved.
analyst.limits: What this verification does not prove
